aviso_en: Mayor and vice mayor elected in 2024, according to the TSE (Superior Electoral Court). There may have been changes since then (removal from office, resignation, death or a special election). The TSE shows no mayor elected in 2024 in this city: the election may have been annulled or may still be under review by the Electoral Courts.

infoCasa.casa_en: São Miguel do Gostoso City Council
notas: A Câmara não registra no SAPL o andamento da maior parte das propostas (79 de 84 apresentadas desde 1º/1/2025): a situação delas aparece como não registrada.
As votações de cada vereador e os gastos do mandato não entram neste site: o sistema de dados abertos da Câmara (SAPL) não publica o voto de cada vereador nem os gastos.
notas_en: The City Council does not record in SAPL the progress of most bills (79 of 84 filed since January 1, 2025), so their status shows as not recorded.
Each councilor's votes and office spending are not included on this site: the City Council's open data system (SAPL) does not publish individual votes or spending.
